meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, wire the DM messaging group to a new agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导创建首个智能体并配置消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速搭建并测试第一个智能体机器人。
copy.tagline_en: Guide through creating the first agent and configuring messaging channels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly set up and test your first agent bot.

howto.what: 引导操作者创建第一个 NanoClaw agent：先选出目标频道，收集操作者的用户 ID、显示名和 agent 角色名，解析 DM 平台 ID，运行初始化脚本建好用户、agent 组和消息组，再向操作者发一条欢迎私信。
howto.when: 当频道凭据已配置、服务运行中，操作者要求为某个 DM 频道创建第一个 agent 时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化第一个 NanoClaw agent，频道用 Discord
say.note: 按提示提供你的用户 ID 和显示名。

say.text: 创建第一个 agent，消息走 Telegram
say.note: 需要先让你给 bot 发一条私信来完成配对。

say.text: 在 Slack 上建第一个 agent 并给我发欢迎消息
say.note: 会引导你完成身份确认和初始化。

howto.what_en: Guides the operator through creating the first NanoClaw agent: picks a channel, collects user ID and names, resolves DM platform ID, runs the init script, and triggers a welcome DM to the operator.
howto.when_en: Triggers after channel credentials are configured and the service is running, when the operator asks to create the first agent for a DM channel.

say_en.text: Help me initialize the first NanoClaw agent, using Discord.
say_en.note: Follow the prompts for your user ID and display name.

say_en.text: Create the first agent, with messages via Telegram.
say_en.note: You'll need to send one DM to the bot for pairing.

say_en.text: Set up the first agent on Slack and send me a welcome DM.
say_en.note: Guides you through identity confirmation and init.
